--- text
a|b
--- keys
Type(X) Cmd+Z Type(Y) Cmd+Shift+Z
--- expect
aY|b
--- note
A new edit after an undo discards the redo stack. Type X gives "aXb"; undo
returns to "ab" with the caret at column 1; typing Y there gives "aYb". That
fresh insertion replaces the future that redo would otherwise restore, so the
redo stack is now empty and the following redo has nothing to do. The result
must stay "aYb" with the caret after Y (column 2). If the redo were to bring
the X back, that would be the classic bug of a redo branch that a new edit
failed to clear.
